The user asked on 2026-11-20 "Lets work on a1+ Unit 6 same all deal as before none stop all approved" (A1+ 6.Y follows A1 6.Y, one step each; fifteen lessons; the Units 2-4 deal: straight to Preview in batches, Gemini 2.5 Flash photos and ElevenLabs audio pre-approved, no per-lesson gates, reviewed in Preview). Four new photos (Gemini 2.5 Flash): Ana by a no-swimming sign at a lake, Ana with her bike by a no-bikes sign, Sofia with her camera by a no-photos sign in a museum, and Diego pointing at an empty park bench. Ana riding her bike (A1+ 2.2) is reused for Yes, you can.

lesson.title: 6.9 Can I swim here?
lesson.unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
lesson.goal: Ask for permission with Can I … here? and answer Yes, you can. / No, you can't. (Can I swim here? No, you can't.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.9 Finding a Safe Way: A1 understands can and cannot in a visible situation; A1+ 6.9 asks for permission. The new items are the question Can I … here? and its short answers Yes, you can. / No, you can't., with the short form can't (You can't swim here.). Each No photo shows the person beside a round red sign whose crossed-out picture is the thing they want to do (swim, ride a bike, take photos); the Yes photos show Diego at an empty park bench and Ana riding her bike in A1+ 2.2's park, with no sign.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 6.9 can and cannot, here; A1+ 1 swim and ride; A1+ 2.2-2.3 bike and camera.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say can't with a long a (KANT) and stress it; say Can I as kən-AI. Do not require native-like speed.
